component.name: TransactionTable
component.business_context: Display a paginated and sortable list of transactions with status indicators and drill-down capability

constraints: Columns: date, amount, status, merchant name, payment method
Pagination options: 25, 50, or 100 rows per page
Status values must display as colored badges

missing_states: hover (row) — no hover highlight state specified for interactive rows
focus-visible (row) — keyboard-focused row must have a visible focus ring
loading — initial data fetch and sort/pagination transitions not specified
empty — no rows returned (e.g. no transactions found for filters)
error — failed API fetch with retry affordance
sorted-asc / sorted-desc — active sort direction indicator per column header
focus (column header) — keyboard-focusable sortable headers need focus state
disabled (pagination controls) — prev/next buttons when on first/last page
accessibility_gaps: Table must use a semantic <table> element with <thead>, <tbody>, <th scope='col'> for all column headers
Sortable column headers must have aria-sort='ascending' | 'descending' | 'none' toggled on click
Clickable rows must have role='button' or be wrapped in an interactive element with tabIndex=0 and an aria-label such as 'View transaction from {merchant} on {date}'
Status Badge is purely visual — each row's status must also be conveyed in text accessible to screen readers (e.g. via visually-hidden span or aria-label on the Badge's container)
Payment method icons (e.g. Visa, Mastercard) rendered via Icon must use aria-hidden=true when the card type is already present as adjacent text, or a meaningful aria-label when icon-only
Pagination controls (prev/next) rendered as IconButton must each have a descriptive aria-label such as 'Previous page' and 'Next page'
Pagination Select for rows-per-page must have an associated label (e.g. label='Rows per page')
Loading state must announce progress to screen readers — Spinner label should read 'Loading transactions'
Empty state must be announced — container should carry role='status' or an aria-live='polite' region
Error state message must use role='alert' to be announced immediately
Amount column values must not rely on colour alone to convey sign (positive/negative); prefix with '+' or '−' symbol
Table must have a descriptive aria-label or be associated with a <caption> element (e.g. 'Transactions')
Focus must not be lost when sort or pagination triggers a data reload — manage focus back to the table or relevant heading
responsive_gaps: On narrow viewports (<768px) a 5-column table will overflow — a horizontal scroll container or column-priority strategy (hide lower-priority columns) must be defined
Clickable row touch targets must be at minimum 44px tall on mobile to meet WCAG 2.5.5
Pagination controls (prev/next IconButtons) must maintain a 44×44px touch target on mobile
Rows-per-page Select must be large enough to tap comfortably on touch devices — minimum 44px height
Sort icons inside column headers must not reduce the tappable header area below 44px on mobile
Amount and date columns may require truncation or wrapping rules on small screens to prevent layout breakage
recommendations: Use Badge with variant='warning' for 'pending', variant='success' for 'completed', variant='danger' for 'failed', and variant='info' for 'refunded' status values
Use Card with interactive=true as a row wrapper if a native <table> is not used; otherwise manage row interactivity with tabIndex=0 and onKeyDown handlers directly on <tr>
Use Spinner with size='md' and label='Loading transactions' for the full-table loading state
Use Skeleton with variant='rect' and appropriate width/height for per-cell loading placeholders during sort or pagination transitions
Use IconButton with variant='ghost', size='md', aria-label='Previous page' and aria-label='Next page' for pagination prev/next controls
Use IconButton with variant='ghost' and aria-label='Disabled — no previous page' combined with disabled=true when on the first page, and equivalent for last page
Use Select with label='Rows per page' and options=[{value:'25',label:'25'},{value:'50',label:'50'},{value:'100',label:'100'}] for the pagination size control
Use Icon with name='chevron-down' or name='chevron-right' (aria-hidden=true) inside sortable column headers to indicate sort direction
Use Icon with name='visa', name='mastercard', or name='amex' with aria-hidden=true when card type label text is present alongside the icon in the payment method column
Use Icon with name='alert' and aria-label='Error loading transactions' inside the error state message container
Use Modal with title='Transaction Details' to render the drill-down view triggered by row click
Apply --color-focus-ring to the focus-visible outline on interactive rows and sortable headers
Apply --color-border-subtle for row dividers and --color-neutral-100 for the row hover background
Apply --font-size-sm and --color-muted-foreground for secondary column data (date, payment method) and --font-weight-medium for amount values
